h1. Payment Analytics Data Dictionary

This data dictionary documents the metrics, dimensions, and facts available in the Payment Analytics semantic view. Use this reference when querying data through the Cortex Agent or building dashboard components.

{info}The semantic view is defined at COCO_SDLC_HOL.MARTS.PAYMENT_ANALYTICS and covers 7 domain tables with merchant relationships enabling cross-domain analysis.{info}

h2. Metrics

The following metrics are pre-defined calculations available for natural language queries through the Cortex Agent.

||Metric||Description||Formula||Data Type||Source Domain||
|APPROVAL_RATE|Percentage of authorizations approved|Approved count / Total count * 100|NUMBER (%)|Authorizations|
|TOTAL_AUTHORIZATION_VOLUME|Total authorization amount in USD|SUM(transaction_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Authorizations|
|AVERAGE_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT|Average transaction amount in USD|AVG(transaction_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Authorizations|
|NET_SETTLEMENT_VOLUME|Total net settlement amount|SUM(net_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Settlements|
|TOTAL_DEPOSITS|Total deposit amount|SUM(deposit_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Deposits|
|EFFECTIVE_FEE_RATE|Processing fees as percentage of sales|Total fees / Sales amount * 100|NUMBER (%)|Deposits|
|CHARGEBACK_VOLUME|Total chargeback dispute amount|SUM(dispute_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Chargebacks|
|CHARGEBACK_WIN_RATE|Percentage of chargebacks won by merchant|Won disputes / Total disputes * 100|NUMBER (%)|Chargebacks|
|CHARGEBACK_RATE|Chargeback count as percentage of total transactions|Chargeback count / Authorization count * 100|NUMBER (%)|Chargebacks + Authorizations|
|NET_ADJUSTMENTS|Net adjustment amount|SUM(adjustment_amount)|NUMBER ($)|Adjustments|
|RETRIEVAL_FULFILLMENT_RATE|Percentage of retrieval requests fulfilled|Closed retrievals / Total retrievals * 100|NUMBER (%)|Retrievals|
|RETRY_SUCCESS_RATE|Percentage of retry transactions approved|Successful retries / Total retries * 100|NUMBER (%)|Authorizations|

h2. Dimensions by Domain

Dimensions are the categorical attributes available for filtering, grouping, and drill-down in queries.

h3. Authorizations

||Dimension||Description||Example Values||
|TRANSACTION_DATE|Date of the authorization transaction|2025-01-15, 2025-02-28|
|MERCHANT_ID|Unique merchant identifier|M001, M042|
|CARD_BRAND|Card network brand|Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover|
|CARD_TYPE|Type of card product|Credit, Debit, Prepaid|
|CARD_CATEGORY|Card category|Consumer, Commercial|
|ENTRY_MODE|Point of sale entry mode|Swipe, Dip, Tap, Keyed, E-commerce|
|APPROVAL_STATUS|Authorization approval status|Approved, Declined|
|DECLINE_REASON|Reason for declined authorization|Insufficient Funds, Do Not Honor, Expired Card|
|PROCESSOR_NAME|Payment processor name|First Data, TSYS, Worldpay|
|IS_RETRY|Whether this is a retry of a prior declined transaction|TRUE, FALSE|

h2. Fact Columns by Domain

Fact columns are the numeric values available for aggregation in queries.

h3. Authorizations

||Fact Column||Description||Data Type||
|TRANSACTION_AMOUNT|Transaction amount in USD|NUMBER|
|TRANSACTIONS_COUNT|Count of transactions (1 per row)|NUMBER|
|RETRY_COUNT|Count of retry transactions (1 per retry, 0 otherwise)|NUMBER|
|RETRY_SUCCESS_COUNT|Count of successful retry transactions (1 per successful retry, 0 otherwise)|NUMBER|

h3. Settlements

||Fact Column||Description||Data Type||
|SALES_COUNT|Number of sales transactions|NUMBER|
|SALES_AMOUNT|Total sales amount|NUMBER|
|REFUND_COUNT|Number of refunds|NUMBER|
|REFUND_AMOUNT|Total refund amount|NUMBER|
|NET_AMOUNT|Net processed amount|NUMBER|
|INTERCHANGE_AMOUNT|Interchange fees|NUMBER|

h3. Chargebacks

||Fact Column||Description||Data Type||

h3. Merchants (DIM_MERCHANTS)

Dimension table -- no fact columns. Used for relationship joins from all transaction domains via MERCHANT_ID.

h2. Relationships

All transaction tables join to the MERCHANTS dimension table through MERCHANT_ID using left outer joins (many-to-one).

||Relationship||Left Table||Right Table||Join Column||
|AUTH_TO_MERCHANT|AUTHORIZATIONS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|
|SETTLEMENT_TO_MERCHANT|SETTLEMENTS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|
|DEPOSIT_TO_MERCHANT|DEPOSITS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|
|CHARGEBACK_TO_MERCHANT|CHARGEBACKS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|
|RETRIEVAL_TO_MERCHANT|RETRIEVALS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|
|ADJUSTMENT_TO_MERCHANT|ADJUSTMENTS|MERCHANTS|MERCHANT_ID|

h2. Notes

{info}This dictionary reflects the current semantic view configuration. New metrics should be added to both the semantic view definition and this dictionary. All queries filter by clnt_id = 'dmcl' for row-level security.{info}

{note}The semantic view supports natural language queries through the Cortex Agent (COCO_SDLC_HOL.MARTS.PAYMENT_ANALYTICS_AGENT). Ask questions like "What is our approval rate by card brand?" or "Show me chargeback trends over the last 12 months."{note}
